name: B10-0521/2025 (PPE) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Myanmar's military leaders to give up power and return the country to the elected government they removed in 2021. It asks for the release of Aung San Suu Kyi and all political prisoners, rejects the elections the military has planned for December 2025 and January 2026, and calls for stronger sanctions, an arms embargo and more aid for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament urges the European Union to widen sanctions and keep the arms embargo on Myanmar's military.
- It backs the National Unity Government as the legitimate representative of Myanmar's people.
- It calls for more humanitarian aid for Rohingya refugees and displaced people.
